meta.title: Teona Hotel | A City Stay in Central İzmit
meta.description: Teona Hotel in central İzmit offers 42 standard rooms, 2 suites, Payidar Restaurant, a meeting room, fitness facilities and a sauna.

home.title: Close to the rhythm of the city, with time to unwind
home.subtitle: Since 2010, Teona Hotel has welcomed guests with 44 rooms and a range of facilities for a practical city stay.
home.introTitle: A practical stay in central İzmit
home.introBody: With 42 standard rooms and 2 suites, Teona Hotel brings Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre and a sauna together under one roof.
home.roomsTitle: Two room types to suit your stay
home.roomsBody: The hotel has 44 rooms in total: standard rooms range from 15 to 20 m², while the suites measure 25 m².
home.standardBody: A simple, practical option for your time in the city.
home.suiteBody: Two 25 m² suites for guests who prefer a larger space.
home.amenitiesBody: Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre, a sauna and a meeting room with flexible seating arrangements are available at the hotel.
home.restaurantTitle: A place to meet within the hotel
home.restaurantBody: Payidar Traditional Restaurant hosts live music programmes and group events.
home.locationBody: Teona Hotel's central İzmit location offers a practical starting point for your time in the city.

rooms.title: Two ways to stay across 44 rooms
rooms.intro: Teona Hotel offers 42 standard rooms and 2 suites in central İzmit.
rooms.standardBody: The 42 standard rooms, measuring between 15 and 20 m², make up most of the hotel's room collection.
rooms.suiteBody: The two 25 m² suites offer an alternative for guests who prefer more space.
rooms.sharedBody: Guests can use Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, the fitness centre and sauna. The meeting room accommodates 40 people in a U-shape and 80 in a classroom layout.

about.title: In İzmit since 2010
about.lead: Teona Hotel serves guests in central İzmit with 44 rooms and a range of on-site facilities.
about.body1: The hotel's room collection comprises 42 standard rooms measuring 15–20 m² and 2 suites measuring 25 m².
about.body2: According to the hotel's promotional material, approximately 120,000 guests have stayed here to date. Teona Hotel also houses Payidar Traditional Restaurant and a meeting room that can be arranged in different layouts.
about.principleTitle: A practical approach to city stays
about.principleBody: Wi-Fi, parking, satellite TV, a fitness centre and a sauna bring together the core facilities guests may need during their stay.
about.cityBody: Its central location makes Teona Hotel a practical accommodation option for business and city plans in İzmit.

restaurant.title: A setting made for gathering around the table
restaurant.lead: Located within Teona Hotel, Payidar Traditional Restaurant provides a dedicated setting for dining and gatherings.
restaurant.body1: The restaurant hosts live music programmes for evening gatherings.
restaurant.body2: For information and planning enquiries regarding group events, please contact the hotel directly.

gallery.title: A look inside Teona Hotel
gallery.intro: Take a closer look at the hotel's rooms, shared spaces and facilities.
gallery.note: The images have been compiled from the promotional materials provided and are representative.

contact.title: Get in touch with Teona Hotel
